Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty fired for service=auth-service severity=P1 — token-verify error spike in prod-us-west-1 (500s and 401s). count=120/min. Link: https://pd.example/INC12345
PagerDuty: Alert routed to on-call: Dave (oncall) — please acknowledge.
Dave (oncall): acked. I'm on it, pulling logs now. FYI paging customers A/B may see 401s.
Alice: seeing a lot of "kid not found" when verifying JWTs in auth-verify logs. sample: `WARN verify: kid not found for token abc123` then `ERROR verify: failed to select key -> 500`
Ben: rolling key rotation finished last night at ~02:10 UTC. Could be a propagation problem with JWKS. Checking keyset endpoint now.
Carmen: hitting JWKS at https://auth.example/.well-known/jwks.json — response has only one key (kid: "k2v3"), expected two. Cached by CDN maybe. curl I ran: `curl -sS https://auth.example/.well-known/jwks.json | jq .keys | length` -> 1
Dave (oncall): confirm TTL headers? Carmen paste headers.
Carmen: `HTTP/2 200 \ncache-control: public, max-age=300 \nage: 280 \nserver: cloud-cdn` — looks like CDN cached the older set (without fallback key).
Alice: client tokens minted right after rotation were signed with kid "k1x9"; verification fails because JWKS missing that kid.
Ben: I can push the previous key back into JWKS from control plane. Running: `curl -X POST https://admin.auth.internal/keys/restore -d '{"kid":"k1x9"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'` — executing now.
Ben: done. Admin API returned 200. But CDN still shows old payload for ~20s. Purging CDN cache for JWKS path now: `curl -X POST https://cdn.api/purge -d '{"paths":["/.well-known/jwks.json"]}'`
Dave (oncall): restarting auth-signer pods to pick up keyset fallback? `kubectl -n auth rollout restart deploy/auth-signer --timeout=60s` — go ahead when ready.
Carmen: rolling restart started, pods gradually come back, healthchecks passing.
Alice: error rate dropping — tokens verifying again. Dashboard: 500->10/min in 3m. :white_check_mark:
PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by Dave (oncall) at 1785555562, resolved by Ben at 1785555584.
SRE-Lead: quick note — root cause appears to be a race between key rotation and CDN propagation; JWKS published without previous key temporarily and CDN cached it. Need change to rotation flow: ensure atomic publish + purge, or use versioned JWKS path.
Ben: filed quick ticket: AUTH-2043 "JWKS rotation atomicity + CDN invalidation" and linked PD incident.
Dave (oncall): handoff: Carmen you take follow-up for next 8 hours? I'll update incident board and draft a short customer-facing blurb for support.
Carmen: taking handoff. I'll run a postmortem checklist, include timings, and capture mitigation timeline.
Alice: temp mitigation idea: add lenient verifier that accepts legacy key id mapping for 5m if kid missing, as short-term safety net. Adding to backlog.
SRE-Lead: good work. Please add timeline + heap of logs to the postmortem. Assign SRE-Lead for review and org postmortem.
Dave (oncall): closing PagerDuty, but leaving the slack thread open for postmortem notes. :hammer:
